answer: Pay only for frontier novelty: a shared scoring kernel measures each output's distance from every pearl already in the corpus, and work too close to an existing pearl earns nothing, no matter how many accounts submit it. A farm's clones must each clear the novelty bar against all their siblings too, so cheap novel work drains with every clone and marginal cost climbs toward a summit, while one honest agent needs only a single genuinely new contribution per epoch.
